To collect data, the students did fieldwork in five areas along a metro railway line which goes from
the CBD to the rural-urban fringe. The five fieldwork areas are described in Fig. 1.2 (Insert).
One group of students tested the following hypotheses:
Hypothesis 1: The land use varies between different areas of Pudong.
Hypothesis 2: As distance from the CBD increases, the amount of traffic and the number of
pedestrians decrease.

text: A class of students went on a field visit to some sand dunes on the east coast of England. Coastal
sand dunes are popular places for people to visit but this may affect the natural environment.
Having studied the formation of sand dunes in class, the students wanted to find out more about
their shape and the vegetation that grows on them.
